name: Fluid Glass
description: WebGL2 glass object that refracts, reflects and disperses a text and image or video backdrop. It follows the pointer, can be dragged, and morphs between shapes on click.
contents: Full-size canvas rendering a raymarched glass shape over a backdrop made of background color, optional image or video, and centered text
Hidden handle div for drag and click hit area
Screen reader only copy of the text
Optional children layered above the canvas
behavior: Glass shape refracts and reflects the backdrop with dispersion, frost, tint and a soft shadow with caustics
In follow mode the shape springs toward the pointer, in drag mode it can be grabbed and thrown with bounce off edges, in static mode it stays at position
Click on the shape morphs to the next shape in the cycle with a wobble
Idle drift and constant spin when enabled, shape stretches and tilts with velocity
Intro scale and fade in on first mount
Rendering pauses when offscreen or tab hidden and throttles when calm
Reduced motion preference lowers wobble, spin, drift and intro
Redraws text when theme class, style or data-theme changes on html, and when fonts load

props.name: fontSize
props.default: undefined (auto fit to width and height)

editableByProps: Text, font, weight, size and color of the backdrop text
Backdrop image or video, fit mode and background color
Glass shape, shape cycle, size, refraction, dispersion, reflection, frost, tint color and strength
Shadow, elevation, interaction mode, smoothness, wobble, spin, idle drift, morph on click and start position
Intro, pixel ratio cap, container class and style, overlay children, shape change callback

needsCodeEdit.where: SDF object, plus SHAPES, EXTENT, BASE and SPIN constants

needsCodeEdit.change: Move or recolor the studio light reflections
needsCodeEdit.where: studio function inside the fragmentFor shader string
light array in the frame function
morph.t update using 0.85 in the frame function

fixed: Requires WebGL2, renders nothing if unavailable
Fills its parent (h-full w-full), the parent needs a defined height
Pointer listeners are attached to window and document element, so the shape reacts to pointer anywhere on the page within the container bounds
Container needs Tailwind classes, including group and data-[grabbing] variants for the grab cursor
Text is drawn in the canvas, so it is not selectable and children do not refract
Image and video src must allow CORS (crossOrigin anonymous)
Video is always muted, looped and autoplaying
Shape radius is capped at 36 percent of the smaller container side
Pixel count capped at about 5 million, heavy GPU shader that may be slow on low end and mobile devices
Shader compile happens on first use of each shape pair, so first morph may be delayed
Recovers from WebGL context loss by remounting the effect

options.look: Biconvex lens that magnifies the backdrop
options.useWhen: Magnifier or loupe effect over text or image
UI like lens over a headline
